about: Words the chat filter masks (server/internal/chatfilter; docs/design/04-backend.md, Moderation). accented: words as written with their Vietnamese marks, matched exactly (lower case), so their unmarked look-alikes stay readable (lồn/lon, cặc/các, buồi/buổi, đéo/đeo). plain: forms typed without marks (only đ may stay), matched only when a word has no other marks; keep them to forms nobody types by accident. Phrases of up to three words are allowed. Letters spread apart (đ.ị.t, f u c k), stretched (fuuuck) or spelled with digits (fvck, sh1t) are caught too.
